job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP for real estate investment consultant services?
job.acceptance: March 20, 2017, 4:30 p.m. HST or explicit equivalent timezone conversion.

reviews.reason: This is a 2023 Illinois TRS RFP for general investment consulting services, not the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP for real estate investment consultant services. Its deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES Issued January 13, 2023 Responses due February 9, 2023, by 2:00 pm CST
The Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois (the System or TRS) is requesting proposals to provide general investment consulting services
